Short quizzes for checking understanding.

- [Python Interview: Basics](python-interview-basics.qmd) — virtual
  environments, package management, and testing.
- [Python Interview: NumPy and pandas](python-numpy-pandas.qmd) — arrays,
  filtering, grouping, missing values, and table joins.
- [SQL Interview Basics](sql-interview-basics.qmd) — filtering, aggregation,
  joins, NULL, and query interpretation.
- [SQL Interview: Intermediate Queries](sql-intermediate-queries.qmd) —
  subqueries, common table expressions (CTEs), set operations, and `EXISTS`.
- [SQL Interview: Window Functions](sql-window-functions.qmd) —
  ranking, aggregation, and analysis over partitions and frames.

*In a later version, interactive quizzes may move to a separate Astro/Starlight
application, with this page linking out to it. For now, quizzes live here as
simple Quarto pages.*
